content:
lina: Quick sync — final SEO checklist for launch posts + post-webinar CTAs. Need owners for keywords, schema, redirect mapping, internal linking plan, and inbound routing. Deadline EOD Wed. :spiral_calendar:
sam: I'll own keyword mapping and on-page meta. Will push keyword buckets to the sheet by tomorrow. @ben can you do canonical tests?
ben: yup. Will run a Lighthouse pass and check canonical/prerender signals. Also will validate Hreflang if we need.
maria: I'll add tracking specs — UTM templates + funnel events for webinar CTAs. Do we want a separate landing or anchored modal?
lina: prefer anchored modal on product pages for conversion parity, but add a dedicated /launch/ landing page for SEO longterm. Need redirect plan from temporary event URLs to /launch/ after 30 days.
sam: For schema, plan to include Event + Webinar schema + FAQ. I'll add the JSON-LD snippets. Sample:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Launch webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.com/launch"}
```
ben: For internal linking, suggest 3 anchor pages: product overview, pricing, docs. We'll add contextual CTAs with rel="noopener" and anchor fragments. Short links to map in the sheet.
maria: On redirects: short-term event pages -> /launch/?src=webinar with 302 until 30d, then 301 to canonical /launch/. Example:
```
/events/apr-launch -> /launch/?src=webinar 302
/launch-old -> /launch/ 301
```
lina: @sam can you create the redirect CSV that ops can consume? Format: source,destination,status,notes
sam: On it. Will drop in the SEO folder and ping @ops-bot for deployment. Also adding meta robots check for /launch/ pages.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: redirect rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC for test, full rollout 06:00 UTC after smoke tests.
ben: small note — watch canonical on paginated blog lists; sometimes CMS adds ?page= params and canonical breaks.
maria: I'll add GA4 event names: webinar_click, webinar_modal_open, webinar_signup_success. Sending spec link: https://go.redwood/analytics/launch
lina: Perfect. After assets: we'll run a quick SERP baseline + rank tracker (ben + sam). Then iterate messaging for the launch post headline. :rocket:
sam: Copy ideas: "Redwood Inference — predictable LLM inference for production" vs "Ship LLM features with consistent low latency". Will A/B test headlines via canonical meta and og:title updates.
ben: All good. Tagging owners in sheet. If no blockers, we'll ship redirects and schema tomorrow.
lina: Thanks team — will follow up with final checklist and assign in Notion. :white_check_mark:
